LBY.note: Reports discrepancies between Civil Registry Authority and national number databases but no exchange of records.
No count or share of people enrolled.
Nothing on who operates the system.
Salaries and pensions frozen and voter-card withdrawals are reported, but the document does not say the registers are keyed on the number.

facts.fact: Libya's Attorney General Al-Siddiq Al-Sour said a review found more than 315,000 national identification numbers issued unlawfully, with 8,662 numbers suspended.
